Basque Country - Bordeaux Quantum Algorithms Meeting
April 9 & 10, 2025

The meeting aims to foster collaboration between the research communities in the Basque Country and Bordeaux around the topic of quantum algorithms. It will feature a range of specialists from both sides of the border, with diverse backgrounds in physics, chemistry, computer science, and mathematics.

Organisers: Javier Aizpurua, Matthieu Saubanère, Yassine Hamoudi

Venue

The meeting will be held at Hôtel Le Bayonne in downtown Bayonne - France (1.5km from the train station). Location on Google Maps.

Registration

Participation and accomodation are free of charge (upon registration), including one night’s stay at the hotel, breakfast on the 10th, and lunch breaks on the 9th and 10th.
